chunks: With this chain of narrators, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Hammad al-Ansari, that he ascribed it, saying:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: A man's tending to his land/estate is from (the trait of) manliness.

key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةِ: Manliness, honor, or integrity (a comprehensive ethical concept)
key_terms.تَعَاهَدِ: To tend to, care for, or maintain diligently
key_terms.ضَيْعَتَهُ: His land, estate, or property being tended to

ai.seo_question: What does the concept of manliness (mur'ah) entail regarding property management in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linking the diligent stewardship of one's property (*di'ah*) to *mur'ah*, a concept in Shia ethics denoting noble character and integrity. This teaching elevates economic responsibility from mere practicality to a spiritual virtue, reflecting the Shia emphasis on balancing worldly duties with moral excellence. It underscores that true manliness involves not just physical strength but the faithful management of resources entrusted by God.

en.basel-kadem: 7.	With this chain of narrators, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Muhammed bin Isa, from Abdullah bin Umar bin Hammad al-Ansari, that he ascribed it, saying:
Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said: A man’s seek to cause harmony in his land is from (the trait of) manliness.
